canonical_project: Google Muskogee-area Summit and Council Hill campuses

status_as_of_cutoff: Site work-construction; official Google and local-government/utility sources now support that the Muskogee campuses are under construction or being built, though no building permit, parcel address, energization date, or campus-specific MW capacity was found.
evidence_grade: B: official company, utility, OCC case listing, and Muskogee County minutes confirm development/construction context; no permit/site-plan record or campus-specific capacity found.

actions.result_status: The published announcement names two Google campuses in Muskogee County at Summit and Council Hill and references local-government participation. It is not a permit or vote record.
actions.access_caveat: Chamber-hosted reproduction; no parcel, case number, or roll call is exposed.
actions.evidence_note: Body/context retained from prior file: Regional chamber reproduction of Google announcement.

actions.result_status: OG&E said the Google electric-service agreements cover three new data centers in Muskogee and Stillwater. It does not identify which building is energized or establish land-use approval.
actions.access_caveat: Utility context only; no interconnection order or energization date is published.
actions.evidence_note: Body/context retained from prior file: OG&E.

actions.action_type: economic infrastructure community equipment fund agreement
actions.result_status: Approved an Economic Infrastructure Community Equipment Fund Agreement between Google LLC and the Board of County Commissioners for the benefit of Council Hill Fire Department; meeting minutes include counsel's statement that Google is building a data center in the Council Hill area. The minutes also say no paperwork was signed/executed by the commissioners to support the motion.
actions.access_caveat: Local-government minutes support construction context and community-equipment agreement only; not a building permit or site-plan approval.

actions.result_status: Google said its long-term energy agreement with OG&E will support its under-construction data center campuses in Muskogee and Stillwater, and that Google will fund new infrastructure and provide capacity purchase agreements from solar facilities in Stephens and Muskogee Counties.
actions.access_caveat: Company source; does not disclose campus-specific MW capacity, parcel address, or energization date.

actions.result_status: OCC current utility cases page lists Oklahoma Gas & Electric Company generation preapproval and special contract under case PUD 2026-000031, matching OG&E's announced large-load/special-contract review path.
actions.access_caveat: OCC landing page confirms case number and category, but not a final approval order or project-specific MW.

sources.match_reason: Exact Phase3↔regional stable-ID pair; seed merged only with explicit evidence

contradictions.summary: Google's April 30, 2026 post describes under-construction Muskogee data center campuses, while PoweredByWho's Council Hill project page, updated May 16, 2026, still labels that campus Announced and says it has no linked public records. Official/company and local-government evidence were weighted higher for status.
